|stats = Increases player's {{Name|Magnetism|class=inline}} by one tile. |value = 50 |gprice = Not Sold }} The '''Small Magnet Ring''' is a [[Rings|ring]] that can be obtained by breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|boxes and barrels]], or as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special monster drop]], on floors 1-39 of [[The Mines]]. It may also be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]], or as a reward for completing the {{Bundle|Adventurer||y}}. The Small Magnet Ring increases the [[Magnetism|magnetic radius]] by one tile. It stacks with another Small Magnet Ring, the [[Magnet Ring]], the [[Glowstone Ring]], or the [[Iridium Band]]. {{NavboxClothing}} [[Category:Rings]] [[de:Kleiner Magnetring]] [[es:Pequeño anillo magnético]] [[fr:Petite bague magnétique]] [[it:Anello magnetico piccolo]] [[ja:磁石の指輪S]] [[ko:작은자석 반지]] [[hu:Apró mágnes gyűrű]] [[pt:Anel de Ímã Pequeno]] [[ru:Малое кольцо-магнит]] [[tr:Küçük Manyetik Yüzük]] [[zh:小型磁鐵戒指]]
